# Healthline

> > Healthline is a comprehensive health information resource providing evidence-based guidance on medications, conditions, treatments, and wellness topics.

Healthline offers FDA-reviewed drug guides, condition overviews, patient advocacy resources, and expert nutrition advice. The site covers a wide range of health topics from diabetes management and cancer treatments to rare genetic conditions, with a focus on practical, medically-reviewed information for patients and caregivers.

## Key Topics

- FDA (Food and Drug Administration)
- Mounjaro (tirzepatide)
- Type 2 diabetes management
- Biologic medications
- Cancer treatment
- Medication administration and injection techniques
- American Diabetes Association guidelines
- Chronic granulomatous disease (CGD)
- B-cell lymphoma
- Interferon gamma-1b therapies
- Rare genetic conditions
- Drug interactions and side effects
- Patient advocacy and self-care
- Nutrition and blood sugar management

## Medication Guides and Drug Information

- [Mounjaro for children: Age limits, safety, and dosage](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/health-drugs-mounjaro-for-children): FDA-approved Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for pediatric type 2 diabetes ages 10-17
- [All About Mounjaro Injection Sites](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/mounjaro-injection-sites): Guide to Mounjaro (tirzepatide) injection sites and administration technique
- [Fluoxetine Interactions: Other Medications, Alcohol, and More](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/fluoxetine-interactions): Drug interaction guide for fluoxetine (Prozac) with NSAIDs, MAOIs, more
- [Dupixent for kids: How it works, how to use it, and side effects](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/dupixent-for-kids): Pediatric guide to Dupixent (dupilumab) for eczema, asthma, and EoE in kids
- [Zepbound Constipation: Causes and How to Find Relief](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/zepbound-constipation): Managing constipation side effects from Zepbound GLP-1 medication
- [Braftovi: Side Effects and How to Manage Them](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/braftovi-side-effects): Managing Braftovi (encorafenib) side effects in melanoma and cancer treatment
- [Actimmune: Uses, Side effects, Dosage, Cost, and More](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/actimmune): Complete drug guide for Actimmune (interferon gamma-1b) for CGD treatment
- [Imaavy: Uses, Side Effects, Dosage, Cost, and More](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/imaavy): Complete drug guide for Imaavy (nipocalimab-aahu) for myasthenia gravis

## Diabetes Management and Nutrition

- [Dietitian Explains How to Build a Blood-Sugar-Friendly Plate](https://www.healthline.com/health/nutrition/diabetes-nutrition-expert-how-to-build-a-blood-sugar-friendly-plate): Dalina Soto's guide to balanced, blood-sugar-friendly meal planning
- [Mindful Partying with Diabetes: The Ultimate Survival Guide](https://www.healthline.com/health/party-survival-guide-diabetes): ADA-backed holiday and party survival tips for diabetes management

## Cancer and Blood Disorders

- [Primary Mediastinal B-Cell Lymphoma (PMBCL): What to Know](https://www.healthline.com/health/what-is-primary-mediastinal-b-cell-lymphoma-pmbcl): Overview of PMBCL, a rare non-Hodgkin's lymphoma affecting B cells
- [BTK Inhibitors for Mantle Cell Lymphoma: What to Know](https://www.healthline.com/health/btk-inhibitors-for-mantle-cell-lymphoma): BTK inhibitor therapy overview for mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) treatment
- [Hemangioma of the Liver (Hepatic Hemangioma)](https://www.healthline.com/health/hepatic-hemangioma): Overview of hepatic hemangioma, a noncancerous liver blood vessel tumor

## Patient Advocacy and Emergency Preparedness

- [Emergency Guide for Acute Hepatic Porphyria](https://www.healthline.com/health/acute-hepatic-porphyria-emergency-prep): Emergency preparedness plan for AHP attack symptoms and treatment
- [How to Self-Advocate for Screenings: A Guide](https://www.healthline.com/health/how-to-self-advocate-for-screenings): Patient empowerment guide for advocating for medical screenings and care
- [Addressing Health Disparities in People of Color with Psoriasis](https://www.healthline.com/health/psoriasis/health-disparities-in-people-of-color-with-psoriasis): NPF insights on psoriasis health disparities and racial equity issues

## Drug Comparisons and Reference

- [Gemtesa vs. Myrbetriq: A Comparison](https://www.healthline.com/health/drugs/gemtesa-vs-myrbetriq): Drug comparison: Gemtesa (vibegron) vs. Myrbetriq for overactive bladder

## Optional

- [Hypersomnia Vs. Somnolence: Symptoms, Causes, and Treatment](https://www.healthline.com/health/hypersomnia-vs-somnolence): Comparing hypersomnia and somnolence: sleep disorders vs. symptom
- [How to Find Alternatives to Alcohol in Recipes](https://www.healthline.com/health/alcohol-alternatives-in-recipes): Guide to nonalcoholic ingredient swaps for cooking and baking recipes
- [Download: How to Reduce Your Risk of Macular Degeneration](https://www.healthline.com/health/eye-health/reduce-your-risk-of-macular-degeneration-downloadable): Downloadable resource for macular degeneration prevention tips
